  • Related Packages

    org.geysermc.paletter.internal
     
  • Class
    Description
    BlockCompiler
    Compiles a custom block to the block property data of one protocol, in the shape BDS 1.26.63.1 sends: {components, menu_category, molangVersion, vanilla_block_data, properties, traits, permutations, blockTags}.
    BlockWire
    Encoders of the generated BlockComponent types: the rules of data/model/mappings.json per protocol window, hand transforms by name.
    Check
    Validation the generated component records run in their constructors.
    ComponentIndex
    Every generated component type by add-on JSON name, and the JSON key of every field of every generated record (record class -> JSON key -> record component).
    ItemCompiler
    Compiles a custom item to the item component data of one protocol: the item properties BDS sends for every custom item, the description's menu category, then each component through its generated encoder.
    ItemWire
    Encoders of the generated ItemComponent types: the rules of data/model/mappings.json per protocol window, hand transforms by name.
    TraitStates
    The block states traits add.
    TraitWire
    Encoders of the generated BlockTrait types: the rules of data/model/mappings.json per protocol window, hand transforms by name.
    Transforms
    The hand transforms named in codegen/model/transforms.json: what no inferred rule explains (each entry there says why).
    Wire
    Value conversions the generated encoders use: add-on JSON values to the NBT type a wire leaf has.
    WireContext
    What one compilation of components targets: the palette's version (its protocol picks the mapping window), where to report what cannot be expressed, and the registry data transforms resolve descriptors against (whether an item exists, the types of a block's states).
    WireContext.Registry
    Item and block lookups for descriptors.
    WireNode
    A mutable NBT compound the component encoders write into by dotted path (minecraft:durability.damage_chance.min).
    WireOnlyWire
    Encoders of the hand-written WireOnlyItemComponents and WireOnlyBlockComponents, dispatched from the generated ItemWire.
